taskA.title: ch13-return flight reset — causal source chain
taskA.verdict: The shipped same-system handoff commits to Origin correctly; the story-world binding reclaims the departure world one render later and ShipController re-seats the ship on the hearth pad. Not a parked ship, not an unready approach shell, not an aim cone, not a speed budget.

rootCause.defect: 'ch13-return' is absent from the runtime crossing-destination table; only 'ch8-crossing' and 'ch10-ask' are listed. The module docstring at :118-127 documents this exact failure mode for ch10, and the boot-resolver comment at :88-96 states ch13-return is owned by its launch world 'exactly as ch10-ask is' — but ch10-ask is in the table and ch13-return is not.
rootCause.consequence: resolveStoryRuntimeWorldId (:138-154) falls through to resolveStoryBootWorldId, which for chapter ch13 with routeOnline returns TIDEGARDEN_WORLD_ID ('-1,-1:p1'), overriding the already-committed Origin crossing.

taskB.title: CG012 standby failure at E.z-3 = (-42, 51.05, 9)

newEstablishedFact.claim: Every authored pose and every route vertex in ch13 sits on even x and even z; with VOXEL_SCALE=2 and worldToGrid = Math.round(coord/VOXEL_SCALE), even world coordinates are exactly voxel-cell centres. The chapter is authored on the lattice.
newEstablishedFact.consequence: CG_STANDBY_CLEAR_OF_E (commonGroundDirector.ts:1950) is the ONLY target in the chapter that is off-lattice: E.z-3 = 9 is odd, round(9/2)=5 -> cell centred z=10, and z=9 is that cell's lower boundary — the maximum possible 3.0 units from the body's terminal cell centre z=12. The exact-goal rescue therefore refuses with goal-outside-terminal-cell. This target could not be handed off even if its cell were dry.

B1.statement: the standby target is off-lattice by construction

B2.statement: cell centred (-42,.,10) was additionally rejected as a goal cell; otherwise the resolved goal would have been that cell and she would at least have walked. Physical reason (wet / unsupported / clearance / edge margin) not measured — no terrain sample taken.
B2.note: authored qualified pose W = (-34,51.05,10) proves the z=10 row is not globally unusable, so B2 is local to x=-42
